name: EPIC 212346061
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 6, 9.8 solar radii and 0.81 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 5,591 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.81 solar masses and 9.8 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,970 K at its surface.
